title: LetheRetentionPolicy
description: Declarative data retention policy schema for Lethe

version.description: Policy schema version. Currently version 1 is supported.

defaults.description: Global execution defaults and circuit breaker thresholds applied across all entities unless overridden.

batch_size.description: Number of rows processed per transaction batch.

max_rows_per_run.description: Circuit breaker: Maximum total rows an entity run is allowed to delete or anonymize before aborting.

max_percent_of_table.description: Circuit breaker: Abort if the planned eligible rows exceed this percentage of the total table row count.

entities.description: List of database entities and their retention policies.

name.description: Unique logical name for this entity policy (used in audit logs, advisory lock hashes, and legal holds).

table.description: PostgreSQL table name to apply retention rules against.

primary_key.description: Primary key column name (single-column primary key only in V1).

trigger.description: Timestamp column (TIMESTAMPTZ) evaluated against the retention cutoff (e.g. last_activity_at, closed_at).

retention.description: Retention window duration. Supported units: 'd' (days), 'm' (calendar months), 'y' (calendar years). Example: '3y', '90d', '18m'.

action.description: Retention action to execute on expired records: 'delete' removes rows (and cascade children); 'anonymize' redacts fields in place.

batch_size.description: Optional entity-level override for the batch size.

children.description: Dependent child tables to clean up prior to parent deletion in the exact same transaction.

fk.description: Foreign key column in the child table referencing the parent's primary key.

hold_if.description: Optional raw SQL boolean expression. Rows where this predicate evaluates to TRUE are protected from retention. Must be trusted SQL.

anonymize.description: Field replacement map for 'anonymize' action. Values can be literals, null, or templates containing '{id}'.

anonymized_marker.description: TIMESTAMPTZ column set to now() when anonymized. Required when action is 'anonymize' to ensure idempotency.
